title: A constructive approach to range characterization of spherical mean transform in odd dimensions
summary: This work focuses on range characterization of spherical mean transform (SMT) in odd-dimension Euclidean space. In a recent work, a simpler description characterizing the range of SMT in odd dimensions was derived. This involved symmetry relations involving certain linear ordinary differential operators acting on the coefficients of the spherical harmonics expansion of the function in the range.
